api/src/services/mcp_client/__init__.py.name: Outside tool connections
api/src/services/mcp_client/__init__.py.description: Connects Bifrost out to outside services that offer their own tools, so agents can use them.

api/src/services/mcp_client/auth_resolut.name: Connection sign-in choice
api/src/services/mcp_client/auth_resolut.description: Chooses which saved sign-in to use for an outside service, covering shared, per-person and per-connection cases.

api/src/services/mcp_client/catalog_sync.name: Outside tool list refresh
api/src/services/mcp_client/catalog_sync.description: Fetches the current list of tools an outside service offers and keeps the saved copy up to date.

api/src/services/mcp_client/client.py.name: Outside service session
api/src/services/mcp_client/client.py.description: Opens a working session with one outside service so its tools can be listed or called.

api/src/services/mcp_client/discovery.py.name: Outside sign-in discovery
api/src/services/mcp_client/discovery.py.description: Asks an outside service how it wants people to sign in before connecting.

api/src/services/mcp_client/dispatch.py.name: Outside tool call
api/src/services/mcp_client/dispatch.py.description: Calls one tool on an outside service and returns a clean, consistent answer to the agent.

api/src/services/mcp_client/errors.py.name: Outside connection errors
api/src/services/mcp_client/errors.py.description: Names the ways an outside service call can fail, so the platform can ask for a fresh sign-in or explain the problem.

api/src/services/mcp_client/oauth_state..name: Sign-in handshake protection
api/src/services/mcp_client/oauth_state..description: Makes the return trip from an outside sign-in tamper-proof and good for one use only.
